name: Okra Plantain Porridge
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 20 g ugu leaves, rinsed and chopped

steps: Combine the plantain and water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 3–5 minutes.
Add the catfish, stock cube, onions, palm oil, okra, and ugu leaves. Stir until a porridge is formed, then cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with the salt and chile-tomato. Serve hot.

culture.text: Porridge is a type of semi-solid food made by soaking, poaching or boiling, in milk or water, ground, crushed or chopped starchy plants, typically grain. It is a traditional staple food of many countries.
